description: Removes provider API keys from browser / client-side tools by putting a fail-closed edge proxy (Cloudflare Worker) in front of the LLM or API call, then rewiring the tool to call the proxy instead of the provider. Activates on: API key in the browser, client-side key, key in the frontend bundle, secret in client code, de-key a tool, harden the client-side-key tools, browser calls the Anthropic / OpenAI / Google API directly, anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access, BYOK hardening, move keys server-side, server-side proxy for an LLM call, Cloudflare Worker proxy, Turnstile gate on an API, harden a single-file HTML tool, stop shipping secrets to the client, keys pasted in a browser modal. NOT for rotating a leaked credential (use managing-credential-lifecycle) or building a full app from scratch (use kyle-vibe-coding).
